title: Nourishing Light Russian Cottage Cheese Pancakes
description: These fermented pancakes are a show-off Russian dish featuring cottage cheese and shio-cure, made with ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients for a nutritious breakfast option.
instructions: In a blender, combine the fermented cottage cheese, shio-cure, eggs, buckwheat flour, sugar, and salt, and blend until smooth.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the melted butter.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter into the pan.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
Serve the pancakes hot with your favorite toppings, such as fresh fruit or maple syrup.
Repeat the process until all the batter is used up.
Keep the pancakes warm in a low-temperature oven while cooking the remaining batter.
